page.layout: One page of text in a single column; a left margin note "Lectio 66." stands beside the italic verse paragraph. Running head at top with page number 370 at its left.

main_text.p: ne fubitò &leuibus de caufsis nobis i-psis difsimiles efficiamur. Ionas dolet metu infamiæ motus, læticia perfundi-tur ob insperatum, opportunum tamen, umbraculum:inuocat Deum,litigat pro-pemodum cum eodem,&c.Hæc sanè in-digna sunt cordato Dei seruo.
main_text.head: VERSVS VII.

p.i: Præparauit autem Deus ipse uermem, afcendente aurora postero die, & percussit cucurbitam,quæ aruit.

main_text.head: THESIS PRIMA.
main_text.p: Corporalia bona & commoda,quibus utuntur homines,Deus,qui ea dat,idque uel mediatè uel immediatè, eadem,cum ei uisum est,aufert:ut caduca & πρόσκαιρα [?] esse,reipsa intelligamus.
Iob: Nudus,inquit,egressus sum ex utero matris meæ, & nudus reuertar illuc: Iehouah dedit,& Iehouah abstulit.sit no-men Iehouæ benedictum.cap.1.21.
Psal.107. inductione idem ostendit,& inter alia uersu 38. Et benedicit eis,& multiplicatur ualde,&iumenta ipsorum non minuit.

page.notes: The right-hand "Hof." sits alone below the last line and is treated as a catchword. The Greek word "πρόσκαιρα" is copied from a small, somewhat blurred print and its accents are uncertain, hence [?]. The "VERSVS VII." and "THESIS PRIMA." headings are set in spaced capitals and are given level 3. Faint marks in the left margin are show-through and are left out.
